text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
We have ourselves a new Triple Crown
champion,
folks! Let's hear it for the
victor of the Satsuki
Sho, the Japanese
Derby, and the Kikuka Sho...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur! She's carved her name into
the annals
of history as a Triple Crown
champion!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I'm a Triple Crown champion...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Amazing... So this is how influential the
title is...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If dreams alone could change anything,
don't you
think that would've happened
already?!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Maybe I should just give up.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(If I knew things'd turn out this way, I
never
would've said that stuff, even as a
joke.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: So this is how it feels.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Didja hear? I'm a Triple Crown champion
now.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The title doesn't suit me one bit.
...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hehe...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: HELL YEAH!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Hahaha!
Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, she's laughing her head off... That
must mean...
she's happy, right?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Beats me... But what are we going to do
about the
interview? She's the Triple
Crown champion, so we
definitely need
a word or two from her...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I really am a Triple Crown champion...
Haha,
hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Reporters A & B
text_block_list.text: I don't want to get near her right now...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: The Triple Crown... Hehehe!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
By the time all the post-race hubbub has
settled
down, Air Shakur is her usual
level-headed self
again.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Now we can finally decide the agenda
for my
senior year.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I wanna keep the spring Tenno Sho and
the
Takarazuka Kinen as my goal races.
Let's start
there.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I'm gonna head down the optimal
route
that Parcae calculated for me—the
one where
every race ended in utter
defeat.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Essentially, I'm going to take on the
hardest race
schedule this country has to
offer.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
But if my fate's changed, then maybe
the results
have changed too. I need to
crunch the numbers
again.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
This year's Japan Cup should be good
too. It'll
have senior-year runners, so it'll
be a decent
reference for what's to
come.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Japan Cup is one of the most
popular G1
races, and Umamusume from
abroad are also
invited to compete. But
what I really want to
know is...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: 14th. Practically dead last.
choice_data_list: What place did 'Parcae' say you'd finish?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
That was the hand I was dealt and the
fate I was
destined to follow... Up until
now, anyway.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, but that doesn't mean things're all
good
now. For starters, I don't even
know why Parcae
predicted I would lose
that badly.
choice_data_list: Still, if that's changed, that means...!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
But like I said, I'm gonna challenge
myself to take
on the ultimate race
schedule.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Of course, that means goin' against some
real
monsters. Especially considering this
year's
contenders... Anyway, that's a
conversation for
later.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna run the calculations again on
my break
and make a new training
schedule based on the
results.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Look over it for me after I'm done.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just as we're about to part ways, I
overhear a
conversation from a nearby
table.

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Wow, the Kikuka Sho had me on the
edge of my
seat the whole time! And
they even crowned a
Triple Crown
champion to boot.

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
I had no idea Air Shakur was that
talented. I was
always too distracted by
her obnoxious behavior
and appearance
to really notice.

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
But forget about that. We've got the
autumn
Tenno Sho to look forward to!
Do you think
Opera O has it in the bag?

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
You bet! She's ridiculously strong! We've
got to
grab some good seats to watch
her win it!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
What are you doin'? Are you staying
here?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just like that, the Kikuka Sho quickly
falls out of
the spotlight. It's hard not to
be bothered by how
fast people are
moving on.
choice_data_list: I'll clean this up and head over right away.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(Just when did my fate change, exactly?
Was it
during my debut race? No, that's
not it.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(It must've happened earlier than that.
But the
only unexpected thing that
happened at that
stage was signing the
trainer contract... Could
that be it?)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: To just show up and act like you can change things! So go ahead... tell me how it'll be different with you!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Did that idiot actually save me? Gimme a break...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Still... At the end of the day, I couldn't
do it on
my own.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(Next thing you know, I'm gonna start
thinking
this is some kinda conspiracy,
like maybe this is
all scripted and it
never mattered what I want.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Well, whatever. I've come this far... Who
cares if
it's a fluke or not?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna make next year my era, whether anyone likes it or not.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After getting home, I reflect back on Air
Shakur's
performance today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She had an overwhelming presence and
powerful
strides. She was practically
glowing on the track...
But the most
impressive thing was her
determination
to win.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At first, I would've been content to see
her
overcome her fate and win. But now,
I want more.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And not just people these days. I want
people
who don't even know about
racing yet to learn
about her and love
her.
choice_data_list: (I want as many people as possible to know about her.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's the desire that's taken root inside
me.
choice_data_list: (I want her to leave her mark――)
